Honestly what level are you in t9? I'd suggest not if you're at least 210, because at that point you can just rush through it, and this months the wyrmhunt so rushing it could be worth it, though many people suggest enjoying the process i suppose, but if you decide on rushing to t10, do a ton of towers before that, t10 towers are harder by a noticeable amount.
Now to answer your original question, i know people's use the t10 one, so this one's probably good for some builds aswell,but this is not a good quality, and i doubt a thief classes needs faction damage anyway, maybe good for some valhallan builds, and sadly i haven't tried the skill

body:
it is normal quality (100%) - it is stat based weapon and you will do the dmg - so you want as high stats as possible - so normal quality is pretty bad. Ornate will be better :)

as others mentioned - T10 version is very good and people use it.
